explication: CozyClay is browser-based previs software for blocking scenes, authoring motion and camera shots, then exporting references for AI video generation. Its primary workflow is scene and cast setup → motion compilation and QA → shot/cut authoring → export. Users can also drive the live studio through its agent panel, MCP server, or terminal client. The map emphasizes documented product stages and sampled runtime links; unsampled subsystem connections are omitted rather than inferred.
